words.sense: outer area or marginal part furthest from the centre
words.connotation: positional; may suggest less central involvement
misconceptions: Assuming every enclosing line is an outer district.

words.sense: boundary line around an area or the distance measured along it
misconceptions: Thinking any location near an edge is the measured boundary.
Confusing the broad outskirts with an exact outline.

semantic_axes.description: Periphery names a region or position near the edge, whereas perimeter names the precise line or measured distance enclosing an area.

edges.boundary_rule: Periphery names a region or position near the edge, whereas perimeter names the precise line or measured distance enclosing an area.

chains.frame: Which word best describes where Salma's shop sits in town?

beats.text: Salma runs her shop among quiet streets far from the main square and its busiest stores.
beats.decisive_clue: the shop is in the outer part of town
beats.reason: The shop is in the outer part of town is the evidence for periphery.

beats.text: It is still within the town, but customers usually reach it from the outer residential roads.
beats.decisive_clue: it occupies an outlying district rather than a measured line
beats.reason: The additional location confirms that this is an area on the outskirts, not a drawn boundary.

chains.feedback_short: The deciding clue: it occupies an outlying district rather than a measured line.
chains.feedback_deep: Periphery describes a marginal or outer region. Salma’s shop is located in the outlying part of town; no enclosing line is being measured.
chains.contrast_rule: Periphery is the outskirts; perimeter traces the edge.

chains.frame: Which word best describes the feature Jonah measures at the park?

beats.text: Jonah walks the park’s complete outside fence with a measuring wheel to find its total length.
beats.reason: He measures the enclosing boundary is the evidence for perimeter.

beats.text: His notebook records the distance for every side before he adds them together.
beats.decisive_clue: he totals the distance all around the outline
beats.reason: Summing the sides explicitly identifies the measured boundary length.

chains.feedback_short: The deciding clue: he totals the distance all around the outline.
chains.feedback_deep: Perimeter can mean the boundary itself or its total length. Jonah measures the line around the park, not a broad outer zone.
chains.contrast_rule: Periphery is the outskirts; perimeter traces the edge.

chains.frame: Which word best describes Priya's position within the club?

beats.text: Priya attends occasional meetings but stays away from the group that plans most debates.
beats.decisive_clue: she is at the margins of the group’s activity
beats.reason: She is at the margins of the group’s activity is the evidence for periphery.

beats.text: She rarely gets involved when the main organisers choose topics.
beats.decisive_clue: she remains peripheral to key decisions
beats.reason: Not planning topics reinforces marginal involvement, not a physical boundary.

chains.feedback_short: The deciding clue: she is at the margins of the group’s activity.
chains.feedback_deep: Periphery works figuratively for the less central part of a group. Priya is involved only at its margins; perimeter is a spatial boundary.

beats.reason: The marking traces the enclosing edge is the evidence for perimeter.

beats.text: A coach checks the marking after rain to make sure the corners are still visible.
beats.decisive_clue: the exact outside outline remains decisive
beats.reason: Rain affects visibility, not the marking’s role as the boundary line.

chains.feedback_deep: Perimeter is the enclosing line. The weather does not turn a court marking into a surrounding outer district.

chains.frame: Which word best describes the position of Layla's flowers in the garden?

beats.text: Layla plants flowers in a broad band outside the vegetable beds and away from the central path.
beats.decisive_clue: the flowers occupy the outer zone of the garden
beats.reason: The flowers occupy the outer zone of the garden is the evidence for periphery.

beats.text: The band is several steps wide, with small shrubs growing through it.
beats.decisive_clue: the outer band has substantial width
beats.reason: The band’s width shows an outlying area, not a single enclosing line.

chains.feedback_short: The deciding clue: the outer band has substantial width.
chains.feedback_deep: Periphery refers to the outer portion of a space. Layla’s plants fill an outer band, whereas a perimeter would be the boundary traced around it.
chains.contrast_rule: Periphery is the outskirts; perimeter traces the edge.
